scripts.build: pnpm --filter worker build && cargo build --release -p agentic-gpt
scripts.dist:linux: mkdir -p dist/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu dist/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu && cross build --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu -p agentic-gpt && cross build --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu -p agentic-gpt && cp target/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/agentic-gpt dist/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/agentic-gpt && cp target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/release/agentic-gpt dist/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu/agentic-gpt
